claims.text: The source defines Adversarial Diffusion Distillation: student from SD2.1/SDXL with 4 timesteps and zero-terminal SNR; hinge adversarial loss with frozen DINOv2 ViT-S heads plus text+image conditioning plus R1 regularisation, plus score-distillation loss (final NFSD variant in pixel space); no classifier-free guidance at inference with iterative refinement.

Reported numbers: COCO-5k 512px ADD-M 1-step FID 19.7 / CLIP 0.326 vs UFOGen 22.5/0.311, InstaFlow-0.9B 23.4/0.304, progressive-distillation 4-step 26.4/0.300; human Elo 1-step beats LCM-XL-4-step, 4-step beats SDXL-Base-50-step; time 0.09 s 1-step vs DPM 25-step 0.88 s (A100 mixed precision, 512px).
